implementations.name: pubsub-bounded-256-batched
pubsub-bounded-256

notes: Every measurement waits for completed listener work and verifies delivery counts, checksums, and FIFO order.
Bounded PubSub capacity 256, replay 0, backpressure enabled, one persistent scoped consumer fiber per listener. No dropping or sliding.
Await-event acknowledges every event. Pipeline-256 publishes chunks with one completion barrier; hybrid uses direct emit and the same chunk barrier.
Construction, registration, explicit GC, correctness assertions, and scoped worker shutdown are outside timing.
The hybrid and public emitter use frozen current source. The full dispatcher comes from the earlier fair comparison. No stale dist bundles are used.
Throughput is per event, not per callback. This is a local batch benchmark, not application latency.

A ready consumer can execute before publish returns; publishing does not guarantee callback dispatch. The busy-subscriber probe demonstrates queued serialization versus immediate public callback invocation.
